scope.subject: standalone gate/up block-scale decoder and sector screen

source.base_subject: docs: close Down flow and admit Gate scale payload
source.cleanup: The standalone CMake target and complete candidate CUDA source were deleted with apply_patch after the first actual fixture triggered the frozen stop-loss.

candidate_format.name: P15E-T128-v1
candidate_format.palette_scope: one shared deterministic top-15 raw E4M3 palette for the layer's gate and up tensors; frequency ties use ascending raw byte
candidate_format.code_contract: four-bit codes 0..14 index the shared palette and code 15 is an exact raw-byte escape
candidate_format.consumption_order: row_quad, K512 tile, lane_pair, phase, row
candidate_format.directory: one little-endian uint32 raw-escape prefix per tile

decoder_topology.description: The standalone kernels consume both gate and up in the same row-quad/K512 order as the selected pair kernel. They reduce decoded raw bytes to one checksum per warp; separate validation kernels materialize every decoded byte.

correctness.lane_major_escape_rank: sum popc(row_mask & lower_lane_mask) over all four rows, plus escape count in earlier rows of the current lane

resources_and_sass.hard_resource_gate: P15E local bytes must equal zero and active blocks per SM must be at least two

performance_protocol.order: B-C-C-B in every round, with an independent B-S-S-B diagnostic for scale6
performance_protocol.candidate: P15E-T128 with a layer-shared gate/up palette
performance_protocol.stop_loss: Reject immediately if any actual round regresses or saves less than 4.6875 us/layer. Skip layer 50 and full gate/up integration when layer 0 fails all five rounds.

method.warning: Nsight Compute reported that data collection happened without fixed GPU frequencies on integrated Orin. These rows diagnose traffic; unprofiled B-C-C-B timings decide rejection.
method.dram_sector_availability: GA10B exposed only MCC DRAM read throughput, not a DRAM byte/sector counter. L1 and LTS byte counts divide exactly by 32 for sector-equivalent counts.

interpretation.finding: P15E lowers L2/DRAM-facing bytes, but directory and sparse raw accesses amplify L1 sector requests above canonical while ballot, popcount, palette lookup, and escape-rank instructions more than double the decoder body. Lower sidecar capacity therefore does not translate to lower decoder latency.

reproduction.ncu_template_before_cleanup: sudo -n /usr/local/cuda/bin/ncu --replay-mode kernel --cache-control all --clock-control base --target-processes all --launch-count 1 --metrics gpu__time_duration.sum,l1tex__t_bytes_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld.sum,l1tex__t_bytes_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld_lookup_hit.sum,l1tex__t_bytes_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld_lookup_miss.sum,lts__t_bytes.sum,lts__t_bytes_equiv_l1sectormiss_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_ld.sum,mcc__dram_throughput_srcnode_gpu_op_read.avg.pct_of_peak_sustained_elapsed --force-overwrite -o REPORT taskset -c 11 BINARY layer0 SHARD 3606039072 SHARD 3611609632 --profile canonical|scale6|p15e
reproduction.note: The exact temporary source was intentionally removed rather than retained behind a test flag because the frozen stop-loss rejected the decoder on the first actual fixture.

decision.reason: All five actual layer-0 rounds regress by approximately 74 us/layer instead of saving the required 4.6875 us/layer.
decision.stop_loss: Do not implement the variable-directory P15E-T128 decoder inside the full gate/up kernel and do not keep its standalone CUDA candidate. A materially different escape-location mechanism requires a new independent zero-code admission and may not reuse this result as positive evidence.

claim_limits: This is a standalone scale-decoder screen, not a full gate/up kernel or end-to-end model result.
The checksum timing intentionally excludes NVFP4 weight loads and GEMV arithmetic so a decoder that fails here cannot plausibly recover the frozen 0.30-ms/token gate inside the larger kernel.
The NCU reports are traffic diagnostics under replay and an integrated-device clock warning; only the unprofiled same-binary rounds establish rejection.
Layer 50 was intentionally skipped after layer 0 failed every formal round, as required by the predeclared stop-loss.
MTP is outside this candidate and outside the current 100-ms/token path.
